body.name: \(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{tail}}\)
body.construction: Set \(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{tail}}=\pi_0\) if \(N<b_{\beta,D}\log(2m)\). Otherwise set \(T_{n,m}=\{N/\log(2m)\}^{1/(2\beta+4)}\), compute \(\widehat S_{xa}(z)=\min\{1,(2m/n)[K_{xa}(z)+1]\}\) at \(z=T_{n,m},eT_{n,m}\), then compute \(\widehat\alpha_{xa}=\operatorname{clip}_{[1,4]}\{\log\widehat S_{xa}(T_{n,m})-\log\widehat S_{xa}(eT_{n,m})\}\) and \(\widehat c_{xa}=\exp[\operatorname{clip}_{[-\log2,0]}\{\log\widehat S_{xa}(T_{n,m})+\widehat\alpha_{xa}\log T_{n,m}\}]\). For each \(\pi\in\Pi_m\), solve \(\widehat M^{\pi}(t)=\tau\) for \(\widehat t^{\pi}\), and return the lexicographically first element of \(\arg\min_{\pi\in\Pi_m}\widehat t^{\pi}\). Finite enumeration makes the construction total; sorting the estimated contrasts at each scalar bisection step is an equivalent implementation.
